mechanism: Both drugs cause nephrotoxicity through different mechanisms; naproxen reduces renal blood flow via prostaglandin inhibition while amphotericin B causes direct tubular damage, resulting in additive renal injury and potential acute kidney injury.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor renal function closely (serum creatinine, BUN) and consider alternative NSAIDs or amphotericin B formulations with lower nephrotoxicity.
